scientific_change_from_baseline: Common leg Kp 500 -> 250; description metadata updated. Kd 10 and baseline last-substep reward sampling remain unchanged.
hypothesis: Lower common leg stiffness may reduce transferred wheel-height/load oscillation. A roughly 6 Hz free controlled mode overlaps observed bounce, but that association does not prove its cause.
tradeoff: Lower stiffness requires larger holding-error compensation and can worsen height/roll/reference tracking; all original gates remain mandatory.
activation_prerequisites: Complete regression suite passes, including unchanged legacy profile behavior and stale-gain rejection.
Actual Isaac actuator gain readback verifies Kp 250 / Kd 10 before PPO learn; any mismatch aborts.
Fresh idle/UUID guard on the chosen authorized remote GPU; native PhysX/Torch/tensor device agreement verified.

training.checkpoint_selection: Predesignated model_final.pt after all 600 updates; no best-of-rollout selection or result-dependent additional updates.

evaluation.conditions: Nominal motors, source reference frame 0 and initial velocity, seed 42, same exported actor including learned normalization.
evaluation.recording: Complete first-episode actual 200 Hz states and ground-contact patches in both engines, with the original 50 Hz policy archive.
evaluation.source_fidelity: Separate unchanged sign/timing diagnostic; do not attribute it to assessor gates.
evaluation.acceptance: At least 0.20 s uninterrupted forward-moving drift with speed >= 0.4 m/s, abs(sideslip) >= 8 deg, both actual bearing ground contacts and lateral patch slip >= 0.04 m/s; all original tracking, support, nonwheel-impact, full-duration and stable-exit gates also pass.
evaluation.diagnostic_comparison: Compare real 200 Hz wheel unloading and height/vertical-velocity oscillation to trial004. Gain readback, same-actor provenance and torque consistency must hold; reward reduction alone is not success.
evaluation.format: Captured car -> TRON1 kinematic reference -> Isaac policy -> MuJoCo same policy; full four-panel recorded video and contact timeline, including failure.

resources.mode: One owned app at a time on authorized remote RTX4090D; no CUDA mask/remapping or changes to other users' jobs.
